title: Same-family sharp source bound and complete additive-six cover

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"Trim_N=the UNCHANGED family.evaluate on ALL N bits: exact alpha=1/(1-beta), logarithmically trimmed SU capacity, inverse-capacity responses, public plateau/tail variable gaps. Its first-tie controller still minimizes the COARSE source_certificate u(p). The sharper v_N is analysis only and does not alter selected plans. Uniform P/empty-witness NP verifier; fallback0,v_N=u_N=N+1.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For each fully guarded plan keep I_u>=O and c from(ST), define sharp(p)=c+1+sum_u[(T_u-1)*(I_u-1)]. At the SAME coarse-controller selected plan let v_N=min(d_plan,sharp(p)); on fallback v_N=u_N=N+1. For EVERY integer N>=0, C_B2(Trim_N)>=4N-8v_N+6>=4N-8u_N+6, with v_N<=u_N for that SAME function. Every nonfallback v_N>=3, so the fully supplied d>=2 additive6 gate refinement, including its complete validated read-once terminal formula cover, applies; fallback is immediate. At EVERY sufficiently large integer N, v_N<=u_N<=2^ceil(D_trim Z), D_trim=139829/50000=2.79658, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)),L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Consequently for each fixed epsilon>0, C_B2(Trim_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths and this SAME fixed eligible family has liminf C_B2(Trim_N)/N>=4.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
